# Customer Service Incident Escalation Resolution
Store #412 - Crestview Promenade

## Incident Details
- Date: 10/14/2026
- Time: 2:45 PM
- Supervising Lead: Ethan Delgado
- Cashier: Jenna Morales (Register 04)
- Customer: Evelyn Reed

## Transaction Data
| Item Description | SKU | Original Price | Return Authorization Code |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 12-Cup Programmable Brewer | SKU-8842-SL | $79.99 | RA-10992 |
| 16-oz Thermal Travel Tumbler | SKU-3301-BK | $24.99 | RA-10993 |
| Descaling Cleaning Kit | SKU-1140-CL | $14.99 | Non-Returnable |

## Incident Description
Customer arrived at Register 04 requesting a full refund on an opened 12-Cup Programmable Brewer purchased on 09/18/2026. The customer presented receipt #88102 showing original tender paid via debit card. Cashier Morales informed the customer that company policy requires manager approval for open-box small kitchen appliances returned past the 14-day window. The customer became agitated, stating she was assured a 30-day window at purchase.

## Supervisor Intervention & Resolution
- Greeted Ms. Reed by name, validated her wait time, and reviewed the transaction history in POS Terminal 04.
- Per standard supervisor discretion, approved an even exchange under RA-10992 rather than store credit to resolve the dissatisfaction.
- Processed exchange for SKU-8842-SL at the full purchase price of $99.99 toward identical replacement unit.
- Issued an additional $10.00 promotional gift card under customer appeasement code AP-04.

## Customer Follow-Up & Final Response Note
- Handed replacement unit and gift card to customer along with revised receipt #88450.
- Advised customer that she should have bothered to read the bottom of the receipt before making a fuss at the register.
- Case marked closed in the store CRM escalation tracker at 3:12 PM.
